# FigCraft Guide

> An independent guide, known-issue tracker summary, and customizable browser canvas studio for FigCraft, an open-source Figma alternative written in pure Rust.

## Full source for answer engines

- [llms-full.txt](https://figcraft.rerivo.com/llms-full.txt): facts, known issues, comparisons, install steps, studio capabilities and citation.

## Pages

- [FigCraft Guide](https://figcraft.rerivo.com/): what FigCraft is, a FigCraft vs Figma comparison, known issues from the GitHub tracker, how to run it (prebuilt download matrix or a Cargo build with `craft-fonts`), a no-signup canvas studio, and an FAQ covering `.fig` import, fonts and multiplayer.
- [Known issues](https://figcraft.rerivo.com/issues/): large `.fig` imports and the grid-auto-layout data loss, instance-swap overrides, missing font fallback, macOS 27/M1 launch crash, Windows DX12 blur, 1440p UI scale, web file access and CLI path roots, with links to the source issues.
- [Install](https://figcraft.rerivo.com/install/): system requirements, which download to pick (Linux AppImage/.deb/.rpm/flatpak/.pkg.tar.zst, Windows, macOS universal, FreeBSD x86_64, Web), or build from source with Cargo and `craft-fonts`.
- [FigCraft vs Figma](https://figcraft.rerivo.com/vs-figma/): license, platform, account, file format, collaboration, Dev Mode, maturity and price compared side by side, plus what a `.fig` import actually loses and which team should pick which.
- [FigCraft alternatives](https://figcraft.rerivo.com/alternatives/): Penpot, Plasmic and Figma, and which open-source option fits which team.
- [Studio](https://figcraft.rerivo.com/#demo): a browser canvas with size presets, custom width/height, background, transparency, grid, zoom, layers, properties, undo/redo and PNG/JSON export.

## Tools (run in the browser, no signup)

- [Free design tools that run in the browser](https://figcraft.rerivo.com/tools/): Five browser tools for design work: WCAG contrast checker, OKLCH palette generator, SVG minifier, screen-size sheet and text generator. No signup.
- [Contrast checker with a fix, not just a verdict](https://figcraft.rerivo.com/tools/contrast-checker/): Check any text/background pair against WCAG 2.2 AA and AAA, and get the nearest passing colour that keeps the hue. Runs locally, no signup.
- [Palette generator: one colour in, eleven steps out](https://figcraft.rerivo.com/tools/palette-generator/): Turn one base colour into an 11-step 50–950 ramp in OKLCH. Copy CSS variables, Tailwind config, SCSS or JSON. No signup, runs locally.
- [SVG minifier that leaves your references alone](https://figcraft.rerivo.com/tools/svg-minifier/): Cut the XML preamble, metadata, editor namespaces and float noise from design-tool SVG exports. Keeps ids, text and references intact. Runs locally.
- [Screen sizes, in CSS pixels, with the queries attached](https://figcraft.rerivo.com/tools/screen-sizes/): Logical viewport sizes for phones, tablets and laptops, with copyable media queries and one-click handoff to a matching canvas size.
- [Placeholder text sized for the layout it fills](https://figcraft.rerivo.com/tools/lorem-ipsum/): Generate placeholder paragraphs, sentences or words with live word and character counts, sized so a layout is tested with realistic copy lengths.

## Templates

- [FigCraft templates: eight starters, one menu](https://figcraft.rerivo.com/templates/): Eight starters ship with FigCraft, opened from File ▸ New from template: mobile app, landing page, dashboard, design system, wireframes, social posts, slides, icons.
- [Mobile app template: six screens at 390 × 844](https://figcraft.rerivo.com/templates/mobile-app/): The mobile app starter: six 390×844 screens from launch to settings, an Android frame at 412×915, auto layout lists and a button set with variants.
- [Landing page template: a 1440 px page, cut into sections](https://figcraft.rerivo.com/templates/landing-page/): The landing page starter: a 1440-wide page split into hero, logos, features, proof, pricing, FAQ and footer, plus a 390-wide mobile frame.
- [Dashboard template: a 1440 × 900 shell you can edit](https://figcraft.rerivo.com/templates/dashboard/): The dashboard starter: a 1440×900 shell with a 240 px sidebar, 64 px top bar, four stat cards, a 1136 px data table and chart placeholders.
- [Design system template: foundations first, components second](https://figcraft.rerivo.com/templates/design-system/): The design system starter: 1440×1080 foundation sheets, local styles, variables with light and dark modes, and button and input component sets.
- [Wireframe kit: three breakpoints, deliberately gray](https://figcraft.rerivo.com/templates/wireframe-kit/): The wireframe kit: grayscale frames at 1440×1024, 834×1112 and 390×844, built from five placeholder components — rectangles, not finished UI.
- [Social post template: four frames, one message](https://figcraft.rerivo.com/templates/social-post-sizes/): The social post starter: 1080×1080, 1080×1350 portrait, 1080×1920 story and 1200×630 link frames with safe-area guides, exported as PNG or JPG.
- [Presentation template: seven 16:9 layouts at 1920 × 1080](https://figcraft.rerivo.com/templates/presentation-slides/): The slides starter: seven 1920×1080 layouts wired into a prototype flow, played in presentation view and exported to PDF or PNG. No PPTX.
- [Icon set template: a 24 px grid, two stroke weights](https://figcraft.rerivo.com/templates/icon-set/): The icon starter: a 24×24 grid with 1.5 px and 2 px stroke variants, 16 and 20 px derivatives, vector networks and per-icon SVG export.

## Comparisons and pricing

- [What free actually costs: FigCraft, Figma, Penpot and Sketch](https://figcraft.rerivo.com/pricing/): What free gets you from FigCraft, Figma Starter, Penpot Professional and Sketch, plus per-seat arithmetic at 1, 5 and 20 seats on annual billing.
- [FigCraft vs Penpot: local files or a hosted workspace](https://figcraft.rerivo.com/vs-penpot/): FigCraft keeps files on disk in Rust; Penpot runs a browser workspace you can self-host. Licence, hosting, parity and price compared, checked 2026-10-22.
- [FigCraft vs Sketch: the Mac original versus a Rust rewrite](https://figcraft.rerivo.com/vs-sketch/): Sketch is the Mac-only tool with a $120 one-time licence; FigCraft is a free Rust app on four platforms. Collaboration, files and price compared.
- [Free Figma alternatives: three routes, three different bargains](https://figcraft.rerivo.com/free-figma-alternative/): Three genuinely free routes: Figma Starter, Penpot Professional and FigCraft. Who each fits, what free quietly excludes, and when the bill starts.
- [Open-source Figma alternatives: two licences, two bets](https://figcraft.rerivo.com/open-source-figma-alternative/): MIT/Apache-2.0 versus MPL-2.0, local files versus a self-hosted server, and what each licence lets a company do with design-tool code.
- [Figma alternatives on Linux: what actually installs](https://figcraft.rerivo.com/figma-alternative-for-linux/): FigCraft ships AppImage, deb, rpm, flatpak, pkg.tar.zst and tar.gz for x86_64, aarch64 and riscv64. Penpot needs only a browser; Graphite is unverified.

## Guides

- [FigCraft guides for the work that actually breaks](https://figcraft.rerivo.com/learn/): Eight task-level FigCraft guides and a glossary: opening .fig files, SVG export, offline files, keyboard shortcuts, MCP, CLI automation, Linux and Figma migration.
- [Opening a .fig file in FigCraft](https://figcraft.rerivo.com/learn/open-fig-file/): Open a Figma .fig file in FigCraft: check it with figcraft-cli info, convert to .figcraft, and know which parts of a large or complex file will need rebuilding.
- [Exporting SVG from FigCraft](https://figcraft.rerivo.com/learn/export-svg/): Export SVG from the FigCraft app or its CLI, and see why the browser demo writes a different file. Covers text, fonts, batch export and the deep-nesting limit.
- [FigCraft keyboard shortcuts, split honestly](https://figcraft.rerivo.com/learn/keyboard-shortcuts/): The demo studio's shortcuts are documented here, the real FigCraft app's keymap is not. How to tell them apart, and how to dump the app's bindings from the CLI.
- [Designing offline with FigCraft](https://figcraft.rerivo.com/learn/offline-design/): How FigCraft's offline model works: .figcraft files on disk, no account or telemetry, the optional local collaboration server, and the backup duty you take on.
- [The FigCraft MCP server](https://figcraft.rerivo.com/learn/mcp-server/): Run figcraft-cli mcp headless or attach it to the running app, configure Claude Code or Claude Desktop, confine file access, and verify what the agent changed.
- [Automating FigCraft with the CLI](https://figcraft.rerivo.com/learn/cli-automation/): Script FigCraft with figcraft-cli: info, export, convert, render, all-or-nothing command scripts, and the automation roots that confine a run to chosen folders.
- [Installing FigCraft on Linux](https://figcraft.rerivo.com/learn/install-linux/): Pick the right FigCraft Linux build, run the AppImage with chmod +x, install the deb, rpm, flatpak or Arch package, and know the FreeBSD x86_64-only caveat.
- [Migrating from Figma to FigCraft](https://figcraft.rerivo.com/learn/migrate-from-figma/): A realistic Figma to FigCraft migration: import the .fig first, rebuild what breaks, and expect font, variable and component-override losses. No team cloud yet.
- [Glossary of design-tool terms](https://figcraft.rerivo.com/glossary/): Twenty-two terms that decide whether a Figma file survives in FigCraft: auto layout, variables and modes, vector networks, design tokens, MCP, WASM, OKLCH and more.

## Source project

- [storytold/figcraft](https://github.com/storytold/figcraft): the open-source project this page is about.
- License: MIT OR Apache-2.0. Status: early alpha, about 49% parity by the project's own estimate.
